question: Should OpenClaw remove these 37 root bundled skills now and ship Sherpa ONNX TTS as an official ClawHub-only plugin for this release?
rationale: The direction fits the lean-core and ClawHub strategy, but it intentionally changes shipped bundled-skill availability, official install trust, dependency graph contents, and native artifact handling.

options.title: Land After Approval And Migration Proof
options.body: Resolve the dependency-graph guard for the current head and document the accepted upgrade path for removed bundled skill names before merge.

options.title: Split Sherpa From Starter Trimming
options.body: Land the Sherpa ClawHub-only packaging separately if maintainers are ready for that trust path but not the broad bundled-skill removal.

options.title: Park Or Close Broad Trim
options.body: Keep the current bundled set until a release-owned deprecation and migration plan is ready.

recommendation.title: Land After Approval And Migration Proof
recommendation.body: Resolve the dependency-graph guard for the current head and document the accepted upgrade path for removed bundled skill names before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the related split PRs and posted the maintainer scope updates that define the remaining decision.
